import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 200;
    static final int MAXM = 100000;
    static final int INF = 199999999;
    static int[][] ma = new int[20][20];
    static int[][] mat = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int n, N, t;
    static String s;
    static int[][] hu = new int[MAXN][3];
    static int[][] re = new int[MAXN][3];
    static int zr, zc;
    static int cx, cy;
    static int[][] stran = {{0, -1}, {0, 1}, {-1, 0}, {1, 0}};
    static int[] dis = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] qu = new int[MAXM];
    static int[] inq = new int[MAXN];
    
    static class Edge {
        int st, ed, flow, next;
        Edge(int st, int ed, int flow, int next) {
            this.st = st;
            this.ed = ed;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }
    
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int E;
    static int src, dest;
    
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[MAXN][3];

    static int isok(int r, int c) {
        if (r > 0 && r <= n && c > 0 && c <= n && ma[r][c] != -1) {
            return (r - 1) * n + c;
        }
        return -1;
    }

    static void BG() {
        N = n * n;
        Arrays.fill(mat[0], -1);
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mat[i], -1);
        }
        for (int r1 = 1; r1 <= n; r1++) {
            for (int c1 = 1; c1 <= n; c1++) {
                if (ma[r1][c1] == -1) continue;
                int p1 = (r1 - 1) * n + c1;
                mat[p1][p1] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    int r2 = r1 + stran[i][0];
                    int c2 = c1 + stran[i][1];
                    if (r2 > 0 && r2 <= n && c2 > 0 && c2 <= n && ma[r2][c2] != -1) {
                        int p2 = (r2 - 1) * n + c2;
                        mat[p1][p2] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        int dd = (zr - 1) * n + zc;
        dis[dd] = 0;
        int front = 0, rear = 1;
        qu[0] = dd;
        while (front < rear) {
            int now = qu[front++];
            for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
                if (mat[now][i] == 1 && dis[i] > dis[now] + 1) {
                    dis[i] = dis[now] + 1;
                    qu[rear++] = i;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void Floyd() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= N; j++) {
                for (int z = 1; z <= N; z++) {
                    if (mat[j][i] != -1 && mat[i][z] != -1) {
                        if (mat[j][z] == -1 || mat[j][z] > mat[j][i] + mat[i][z]) {
                            mat[j][z] = mat[j][i] + mat[i][z];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void addedge(int st, int ed, int flow) {
        edges[E] = new Edge(st, ed, flow, head[st]);
        head[st] = E++;
        edges[E] = new Edge(ed, st, 0, head[ed]);
        head[ed] = E++;
    }

    static void BF() {
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        E = 0;
        src = 0;
        dest = cx + cy + 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++) {
            addedge(src, i, hu[i][2]);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= cy; i++) {
            addedge(cx + i, dest, re[i][2]);
        }
        int dd = (zr - 1) * n + zc;
        for (int i = 1; i <= cx; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= cy; j++) {
                int p1 = (hu[i][0] - 1) * n + hu[i][1];
                int p2 = (re[j][0] - 1) * n + re[j][1];
                if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= t && mat[p1][p2] < dis[p2]) {
                    addedge(i, cx + j, INF);
                } else if (mat[p1][p2] != -1 && mat[p1][p2] <= t && mat[p1][p2] == dis[p2]) {
                    for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                        int rr = re[j][0] + stran[z][0];
                        int cc = re[j][1] + stran[z][1];
                        int pp = isok(rr, cc);
                        if (pp != -1) {
                            if (mat[p1][pp] == mat[p1][p2] - 1 && mat[p1][pp] < dis[pp]) {
                                addedge(i, cx + j, INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int d[] = new int[MAXN];

    static boolean dinic_bfs() {
        int[] que = new int[MAXN];
        int front = 0, rear = 0;
        que[rear++] = src;
        Arrays.fill(d, -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        while (front < rear) {
            int now = que[front++];
            for (int i = head[now]; i != -1; i = edges[i].next) {
                int ed = edges[i].ed;
                if (d[ed] == -1 && edges[i].flow > 0) {
                    d[ed] = d[now] + 1;
                    if (ed == dest) return d[dest] >= 0;
                    que[rear++] = ed;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int[] stk = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] cur = new int[MAXN];

    static int dinic() {
        int ret = 0;
        while (dinic_bfs()) {
            int u = src, tail = 0;
            System.arraycopy(head, 0, cur, 0, head.length);
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.length; i++) {
                cur[i] = head[i];
            }
            while (cur[src] != -1) {
                if (u != dest && cur[u] != -1 && edges[cur[u]].flow > 0 && d[u] != -1 && d[u] + 1 == d[edges[cur[u]].ed]) {
                    stk[tail++] = cur[u];
                    u = edges[cur[u]].ed;
                } else if (u == dest) {
                    int minf = INF;
                    for (int i = tail - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                        if (edges[stk[i]].flow < minf) minf = edges[stk[i]].flow;
                    }
                    for (int i = tail - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                        edges[stk[i]].flow -= minf;
                        edges[stk[i] ^ 1].flow += minf;
                        if (edges[stk[i]].flow == 0) tail = i;
                    }
                    u = edges[stk[tail]].st;
                } else {
                    while (tail > 0 && u != src && cur[u] == -1) u = edges[stk[--tail]].st;
                    if (cur[u] != -1) {
                        cur[u] = edges[cur[u]].next;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static int solve() {
        ma[zr][zc] = 0;
        BG();
        spfa();
        ma[zr][zc] = -1;
        BG();
        Floyd();
        BF();
        int res = dinic();
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        cx = cy = 0;
        for (int[] row : ma) {
            Arrays.fill(row, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(mat[i], -1);
        }
        zr = -1;
        zc = -1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') ma[i][j + 1] = -1;
                else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    zr = i; zc = j + 1;
                    ma[i][j + 1] = -1;
                } else if (Character.isDigit(ch) && ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    cx++;
                    hu[cx][0] = i;
                    hu[cx][1] = j + 1;
                    hu[cx][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            s = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = s.charAt(j);
                if (Character.isDigit(ch) && ch > '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    cy++;
                    re[cy][0] = i;
                    re[cy][1] = j + 1;
                    re[cy][2] = ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solve());
    }
}
